title: Molecular dynamics simulation and docking studies reveals inhibition of NF-kB signaling as a promising therapeutic drug target for reduction in cytokines storms.
authors: Kumar, Abhishek; Bharadwaj, Tharun; Muthuraj, Likith; Kumar, Jitendra; Kumar, Pravin; Lalitha, Roopa; Sigamani, Gladstone; Ahmad, Shaban; Bhanu, Piyush; Pathak, Ravi Kant; Uttarkar, Akshay; Niranjan, Vidya; Mishra, Vachaspati
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟筛选NF-kB(p50/p65)-DNA复合物的小分子抑制剂，聚焦TF-DNA结合抑制与互作机制，方法为AI辅助设计与物理模拟，但核心是药物发现而非TF-DNA结合机制建模。
abstract: Nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kB) plays a crucial role in numerous cellular processes, such as inflammation, immunological responses to infection, cell division, apoptosis, and the development of embryos and neurons. Cytokines, plays an important role in positive feedback loop and leads to inflammatory cell death through the release of pathogenic cytokine known to be cytokine storm which causes diseases like Acute Respiratory Disorder (ARD), multi-organ disorder, Hyperinflammation syndrome and may cause death. This cytochrome storm was identified in the people severely affected by covid-19. NF-kB presents a promising therapeutic opportunity to mitigate covid-19-induced cytokine storm and reduce the risk of severe morbidity and mortality resulting from the diseases. This paper therefore explores the modulation of the NF-kB pathway by inhibiting the binding of the transcription factor as a potential strategy to mitigate the morbidity and mortality caused by cytokine storms. To identify small molecule inhibitors of NF-kB signaling, we screened approximately 101 molecules in two identified pockets of NF-kB (p50/p65)-DNA complex. Each molecule was virtually screened in two pockets (A1 and A2). The focus library was developed starting from chemical structures obtained from the literature (Angelicin and Psolaren) which shows the inhibition of NF-kB signaling, as well as using artificial intelligence (WADDAICA) and rationally designed molecules. Among the 3 highest-scored ligands (NFAI64, NF30 and NF49) selected from the docking studies and further molecular dynamic investigations. The identified compound NF30 showed significantly higher binding affinity (DeltaG(binding)) in A2 pocket (60.92 +/- 1.83 kJ/mol) as compared to the rest of the molecules, making it a promising molecule for the inhibition of NF-kB. The discovered novel compounds by computational studies could be of relevance to identify more potent inhibitors of NF-kB dependent biological functions beneficial to control the cytokine storm occurring in the patients affected with Covid-19.
abstract_zh: 核因子-kappa B（NF-kB）在众多细胞过程中扮演关键角色，例如炎症、对感染的免疫应答、细胞分裂、凋亡以及胚胎和神经元的发育。细胞因子在正反馈环路中发挥重要作用，并通过释放致病性细胞因子导致炎症性细胞死亡，这种细胞因子被称为细胞因子风暴，其可引发急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARD）、多器官功能障碍、过度炎症综合征等疾病，并可能导致死亡。这种细胞色素风暴在严重感染covid-19的人群中被识别。NF-kB为缓解covid-19诱导的细胞因子风暴以及降低由此类疾病导致的严重发病率和死亡率提供了有前景的治疗机会。因此，本文探讨了通过抑制转录因子结合来调节NF-kB通路，作为减轻细胞因子风暴所致发病率和死亡率的潜在策略。为识别NF-kB信号传导的小分子抑制剂，我们在NF-kB（p50/p65）-DNA复合物的两个已识别口袋中对约101个分子进行了筛选。每个分子在两个口袋（A1和A2）中进行了虚拟筛选。聚焦文库基于从文献中获得的化学结构（Angelicin和Psolaren）开发，这些结构显示出对NF-kB信号传导的抑制作用，同时结合了人工智能（WADDAICA）和理性设计的分子。在从对接研究中选出的3个最高得分配体（NFAI64、NF30和NF49）中，进一步进行了分子动力学研究。鉴定出的化合物NF30在A2口袋中显示出显著更高的结合亲和力（DeltaG(binding)）为60.92 +/- 1.83 kJ/mol，相较于其他分子，使其成为抑制NF-kB的有前景分子。通过计算研究发现的新型化合物可能有助于识别更有效的NF-kB依赖性生物功能抑制剂，从而有利于控制Covid-19患者中发生的细胞因子风暴。
